what: Pavers, base gravel, sand and edging for a patio or path
title: Paver Calculator: Pavers, Base Gravel and Sand for a Patio | Calcupine
description: Free paver calculator. Get the number of pavers, tons of base gravel, bags of bedding sand and edge restraint for a patio, walkway or fire pit area.
lede: Enter your patio or path area and paver size. Get the pavers, base gravel, bedding sand and edging you need. Curved and L-shaped patios work too.

faq.q: How many pavers do I need for a 12x12 patio?
faq.a: A 12 by 12 patio is 144 sq ft. Standard 4 by 8 inch pavers cover 0.22 sq ft each, so you need 648, or 713 with 10% extra for cuts.

faq.q: How deep should the base be for pavers?
faq.a: About 4 to 6 inches of compacted crushed stone for patios and walkways, and 8 to 12 inches for driveways, according to paver maker Unilock. Clay soils may need more.

faq.q: How much sand do I need under pavers?
faq.a: A bedding layer about 1 inch deep is common. 144 sq ft at 1 inch is 12 cubic feet, or 24 bags of 0.5 cubic feet.

faq.q: How much extra should I order for cuts?
faq.a: About 5 to 10% for straight patterns and 15% for herringbone or curved edges.
